name: What is the process for designing and installing custom built-ins with Hometelligent Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for designing and installing custom built-ins with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, functional requirements, and budget. Following this, we develop detailed designs and material selections for your approval. Once finalized, we proceed with custom fabrication and then schedule the on-site installation. Throughout the process, open communication is key to ensuring the final product meets your expectations and integrates perfectly into your space.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design, material selection, fabrication, and on-site installation, with client approval at each stage.
